runsheet.short_description: Join Slack channels corresponding to your session: #award-nominees-? and most importantly, #award-nominees-?-presenters.
Tell presenters their session slot and presentation position. Remind each presenter to keep their mode of attendance up to date via Google Form.
Use your own laptop to test open all slide submissions. Your laptop will not be used during the Oral Session, but is a good sanity check.

Review name pronunciations. In #award-nominees-?-presenters, re-send the presentation order, re-send the link to the prep room Zoom Meeting, remind on-site presenters to sit in the front row, and remind online presenters to join the prep room 5 minutes before their turn.
runsheet.more_info: Find all info in channel description or pinned message.

runsheet.short_description: [[Prep Room Assistant]] enters the prep room. Then, join Slack channel #award-nominees-?-presenters. Then, report being ready to [[Zoom Master]] on Slack channel [#internal-helpdesk-for-volunteer-and-organizers](https://ismir2026.slack.com/archives/C0CAA9DBFJ6). Stay in the prep room for the entire session.
Go to the stage laptop. Keep the [Sheet for Session Chair](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JPkY1TY8BfC07ZicIe6FDiZt94PALu3r6AFXhavpwlY/edit?gid=1217880391#gid=1217880391) open.
runsheet.more_info:
Do not download slides. During presentation, for Google slides, use the web view; for slides files, downloading is fast. This ensures up-to-date slides.
If the previous event before your session uses the auditorium, do this instead at T-1 min.

runsheet.short_description: [[Webinar Sentinel]] confirm where [[Zoom Master]] will sit. [[Zoom Master]] says hi to and assist [[Award Session Chair]] on the stage.
Disable Zoom Chat for attendees.
runsheet.more_info: Chat > menu > attendees can chat with: nobody.

runsheet.short_description: Promote [[Webinar Sentinel]], [[Q&A Tracker]], and maybe backstage to cohost in the Zoom webinar.
[[Q&A Tracker]] and [[Award Session Chair]] agree on the Q&A signal.
Grab a mic and keep it for the whole session.
Sit in the corner of the stage. Join Zoom on the provided laptop and disconnect audio+video. Keep both the Q&A panel and the participants view (for raised hands) open at all times.

Sit on-site in the backstage but view only the Zoom Webinar on the provided laptop. Not only listen, but try to understand and enjoy the presentaions --- you catch more issues this way. Keep the on-site screen visible so any mismatch is catched, but pay main attention to the webinar. Use the provided headphones. Upon issues, use judgement: Either unmute to raise the issue, or contact the [[Zoom Master]] immediately by walking to them.
Sit in the corner of the audience to enjoy the presentations.

Introduce your name, institution, and your role as the Award Session Chair. Announce the form of presentation + Q&A, and introduce your gestures/cards for '8 minutes passed' and '10 minutes passed'. Sit with the [[Q&A Tracker]] in the corner of the stage.
runsheet.more_info: Cards: maybe simply write with pen and paper?

runsheet.short_description: where T<sub>y</sub> is the start of each presentation. If the next presenter has not joined the prep room, send a reminder in #award-nominees-?-presenters. If they have, go through these checks: they can hear you, you can hear them, they can see you, you can see them, they can share screen (ticking 'Share Sound', you can see the screen, and you can hear shared sounds. Then, stop their screenshare and remind them to tick 'Share Sound' when in the real Webinar. Paste the link to the Webinar in the Zoom Chat and let them click it. After they are gone, report in [#internal-helpdesk-for-volunteer-and-organizers](https://ismir2026.slack.com/archives/C0CAA9DBFJ6). If that was the last presenter, feel free to hop to the Webinar.
runsheet.more_info: Convenient sound source: Any video on YouTube / Miniconf.

runsheet.short_description: here T<sub>y</sub> is the start of each presentation. For one whole minute, monitor the attendee list. When the next presenter joins, promote them to panelist.

where T<sub>y</sub> is the start of each presentation. If the presenter is on-site, make sure they are ready and by the stage, and open the right slides. If the presenter is online, instruct them to unmute, open video camera, and share screen (reminding them to tick 'Share Sound'), and wait until you see the shared screen. Introduce the paper title and the presenter.
runsheet.more_info: If an online presenter does not show, tweak the order. If an online presenter joins but has technical issues, let them join the prep room again and tweak presentation order. If the last presenter has issues, consider live troubleshooting with [[Zoom Master]].

runsheet.short_description: If the previous presenter is online, demote them from panelist to attendee. If [[Award Session Chair]] turns the presenter back to the prep room, immediately inform the [[Prep Room Assistant]] on Slack channel [#internal-helpdesk-for-volunteer-and-organizers](https://ismir2026.slack.com/archives/C0CAA9DBFJ6).
Signal the presenter.
Signal the presenter again. From this point on, use your judgement whether to barge in and stop the presentation. Consider remaining time.
runsheet.more_info: Consider that this session is the last one in the afternoon.

runsheet.short_description: Annouce Q&A begins. Pick the questions, balancing online VS on-site questions. Keep track of time; in due time, end the Q&A.
When there is an online question, signal the [[Award Session Chair]]. When the [[Award Session Chair]] takes it, read it / unmute the attendee and call him/her to speak up.
Whenever a question from the on-site audience is taken, give your mic to them.
Announce the end of the Award Nominee Oral Session, thank the presenters, and declare the end of afternoon activities.
End Webinar for All.
